description: Resolves a Zambian mineral licence code to a binary verified or not-verified verdict against four checks, each traceable to a published government register.
gate_definition: verified is true only when all four checks pass. Deliberately binary: a rich per-lot provenance payload fragments a fungible commodity and harms price discovery, whereas a binary gate concentrates liquidity into a single pool. Check detail is returned for audit, not for trading.

checks.requirement: The licence class must permit minerals to be produced for sale
The licence must not appear in a cancellation or default notice
The holder must have declared its beneficial owners
The holder must be current on statutory annual returns

value.name: NGDR active mineral licence register
value.covers: licence code, type, holder, commodities, area, expiry, coordinates

value.name: Cancellation and default notices
value.publisher: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development, Zambia
value.covers: MLC 78 cancellations, 2023 and 2025 public default notices

value.name: PACRA companies registry
value.publisher: Patents and Companies Registration Agency, Zambia
value.covers: entity number, status, declared business, beneficial ownership, annual returns

licence_terms: Derived from Zambian public registers. Reuse freely with attribution to this project and to the underlying government sources named above.
